verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Ab'i, ha t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Judá ix in sik'kanel winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur.
Toxo ix wak'och Wespíritu t'a winh, yik jelan sna'anel winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e yalnhej tastak winh.
Ol sna'anelta winh sb'o'an yechel jantak munlajel ol b'o'ok, icha t'a k'e'en oro, t'a k'e'en plata yet' t'a k'e'en bronce,
yet' pax sb'o'an k'e'en k'e'en winh wach' yilji, sb'o'an te te' t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal.

Haxo winhaj Aholiab, yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal winhaj Dan, a winh ol kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Masanil heb' aytaxon sjelanil, ix in wach' ak'ej sjelanil heb' yik a heb' ol b'oan masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach:
Haton k'apak mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a, te' skaxail in trato yet' smakul b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul, masanil syamk'ab'il t'a yol mantiado chi',
te' mexa yet' jantak syamk'ab'il, jun sb'akhnub' candil nab'a oro yet' syamk'ab'il, jun altar b'aj snhuschaj incienso,
jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' syamk'ab'il, jun niwan palangana yet' sb'akhnub' yich,
k'apak pichul jalb'il niwan yelk'ochi, haton spichul winhaj sacerdote Aarón yet' pax spichul heb' yuninal winh, haton pichul sk'an heb' t'a yopisio.

Sb'opax aceite heb' sk'anchaji ayik tz'ochkan junok mach, ma junok tas wikok. Sb'opax incienso manhxo jantakok swach'il sk'anchaj t'a in kajnub'. Ha juntzanh chi', yowalil sb'o heb' icha wal ix aj walan t'ayach, xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':

Al t'a heb' etchonhab' to yowalil sk'anab'ajej jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', yujto wik yaji. Yujto a jun k'u chi' yechel in trato yajkanoch t'a ko kal heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo yik wach' tzeyojtakejeli to a in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'kanel wikok.
Niwanokab' yelk'och jun sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi' t'a yol he sat. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi', yowalil schami. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', yowalil schami.
Wakenhej k'uhal tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, wiknhej yaji. Yalnhej mach smunlaj t'a jun k'u chi', tojolnhej schami.

Yuj chi', yowalil tze k'anab'ajej jun k'uhal ik'oj ip chi'. Ha jun chi' yechel in trato tz'ajkan t'a masanil tiempo t'a ko kal heyet'ok, yujto a in Jehová in t'a wake' k'uhal in b'onak satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik, haxo t'a yukil k'uhal wochnak wa'an in munlaji, wik'annak wip, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés t'a jolom witz Sinaí, ix yak'an chab' pachanh k'e'en t'a winh, b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch strato, to a wal Dios ix tz'ib'ani.
